brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: piece:0,0,0;half-s alone at level 0, no adjacent pieces and no level 1 piece; half-n/quarter variants tested all alone also offer ≤1 drawer

Configurator only offers 1 drawer socket on a half base (s on half-n, n on half-s) and 0 on full/quarter bases; after placing drawer:0#0,0#cut find_sockets drawer returns 0. Five drawers in a single base is not offered by placement rules.

finish.summary: Single-base limit enforced (half-s alone). Max 1 drawer achievable; 5 drawers in a single hex base not placeable per current sockets/rules. Build left with 1 drawer to show closest possible; brief requirement for 5 is unmet.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
